usage: Starts with {st:Charge} Count on herself and allies. Her unique Charge is {st:ChargeNoirAlly}. {st:NoirShieldUpDonQuixote} is generated whenever she overcaps or consumes {st:ChargeNoirAlly} or when allies with Shields are hit. The buff passively gives her shields, {st:SuperCoin} at 25+ stack, and Stagger immunity at 40+ stack. At 100, her defense will consume all of it to trigger {skill:10315|06} instead.

Except for her S1, her skills apply {st:NoirNailDonQuixote} which is used for her conditionals along with {st:Vibration}. It also applies some bonus {kw:Sloth} damage on {st:VibrationExplosion} and {st:Binding} at 4+ stack. Whenever a {st:VibrationExplosion} is triggered on a target with it, her passive also gives her and an ally +2 {st:Charge} Count.

Her S3 applies {st:OathFieldDonQuixote} for 3 turns which generates shield on all allies, {st:AttackUp} and {st:DefenseUp} to Le Noir allies, and -1 speed and a minor stagger and damage taken debuff against enemies.

Both her S3 and {skill:10315|06} triggers {st:Switch_Vibration} into {st:VibrationFocusing} which is another {st:Vibration} variation that deals bonus damage on {st:VibrationExplosion}. This one is based on the {st:Charge} of the unit that triggers the {st:VibrationExplosion} but consumes an extra {st:Vibration} count unless it's a Le Noir identity.
She uses {skill:10315|05} as a bonus skill before Le Noir allies attack a target.

1031501.desc:
Combat End: If this unit has [OathFieldDonQuixote], gain 1 [Agility] next turn

This unit's Base Attack Skills deal +([ChargeNoirAlly] Potency on self x 3)% damage against the main target (max 15%)
1031501.flavor: I heard His voice, His promise: "Everything that exists has meaning."
1031501.name: Obsidian Covenant

1031502.desc:
Upon entering the Encounter for the first time, gain +10 [ChargeNoirAlly] Count and apply +2 [Charge] Count on other "Le Noir" allied Identities

When inflicting [NoirNailDonQuixote] using Skill effects:
- At 12+ [ChargeNoirAlly] Count, inflict +1 more [NoirNailDonQuixote] and consume 4 [ChargeNoirAlly] Count
- At fewer than 12 [ChargeNoirAlly] Count, consume 2 [ChargeNoirAlly] Count
- At insufficient [ChargeNoirAlly] Count, does not inflict [NoirNailDonQuixote]
- Skills that inflict [NoirNailDonQuixote] due to this effect count as Skills that consume [Charge] Count

Gain 1 [ChargeNoirAlly] Potency every time this unit consumes 10 cumulative [ChargeNoirAlly] Count in this Encounter
1031502.flavor: A hammer drives nails. This hammer strikes nothing but nails. Whatever it strikes is a nail. That is what was agreed upon.
1031502.name: Malleus Promissionis

1031503.desc:
Upon entering the Encounter for the first time, gain 25 [NoirShieldUpDonQuixote]

When consuming [ChargeNoirAlly] Count, or when gaining [ChargeNoirAlly] Count past its max cap, gain ([ChargeNoirAlly] Count consumed or surplus [ChargeNoirAlly] Count x 5) [NoirShieldUpDonQuixote] (max 30 per turn)

When an allied Identity that has Shield is hit, this unit gains 2 [NoirShieldUpDonQuixote] (max 10 per turn)
- If the said allied Identity is a [PersonalityCharge], gain 5 [NoirShieldUpDonQuixote] instead
1031503.name: Mission of Conservation

1031504.desc:
Before Attack of another "Le Noir" allied Identity on an enemy, this unit uses "Judgment!" Skill as an Unopposed Attack against the main target (once per turn)

On the final Coin Start of a Base Skill, the said Coin gains Final Power +([ChargeNoirAlly] Potency on self + ([NoirNailDonQuixote] on target / 2)) (max 5)

If this unit has [OathFieldDonQuixote], Base Skill 1/2/3 gains Clash Power +1/+2/+3

When [VibrationExplosion] triggers on a target that has [NoirNailDonQuixote], this unit and 1 other allied [PersonalityCharge] that has the lowest [Charge] Count gain +2 [Charge] Count (2 times per turn)
1031504.flavor: The Obsidian God's words be our guiding light, our armor and shield in this troubled world of uncertainties; becometh His Voice the shining beam of light upon us, thereby bestowing us with meaning so coveted.
1031504.name: The Lord's Will and Values Be With Us...

This unit's Base Attack Skills deal +([ChargeNoirAlly] Potency on self x 6)% damage against the main target (max 30%)
1031511.flavor: I heard His voice, His promise: "Everything that exists has meaning."
1031511.name: Obsidian Covenant

1031521.desc: All allied [PersonalityCharge] take -2% damage this turn for every allied [PersonalityCharge] on the field at Combat Start (max -10%)
1031521.name: Formation Conservation
